name: Bandits

variantInfo.name: Bandit
notes: Level 22 Wilderness bandit at the Bandit Camp east of the Ruins; 27 hitpoints, negligible defensive bonuses.
Aggressive to all players regardless of combat level.

variantInfo.name: Bandit
notes: Level 130 Wilderness bandit; 155 hitpoints, defence level 55 with negligible defensive bonuses.
Drops Larran's keys and Slayer's enchantments while on a Krystilia task; also has a single spawn in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.

locationComparison.name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
notes: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins holds both the level 22 and level 130 bandits.
Bandits are aggressive; approach with caution.
Multicombat, cannon placement and safespots are not wiki-stated for this camp; conservative defaults are used.

taskNotes: Bandits are assigned only by Krystilia and must be killed in the Wilderness to count; there is no combat, Slayer or quest requirement.
slayerTargetId 252 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract: 252 + worklist index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
This task refers to the Wilderness Bandit Camp bandits (level 22 and level 130) east of the Ruins, NOT the Kharidian Desert or Pollnivneach bandits, which do not count.
The bandits are aggressive to all players; take caution when approaching the camp.
Their defensive bonuses are negligible, so any accurate melee weapon works well; magic and ranged are also viable given zero magic/ranged defence.
No task extension unlock exists for Bandits.
recommendedMethod: Kill the aggressive Wilderness Bandit Camp bandits (level 22 and level 130) with any accurate melee weapon; their defensive bonuses are negligible. Bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear as the camp is deep in a PvP zone.
